Name: Portrait Settings for Vanilla and Expanded
Author: TenSkyline
Description:
[size=3]This mod helps you use portraits from other mods that do not yet have configuration settings or are not compatible by default because of its size.[/size]

[b][color=#ff0000][size=5]Instalation[/size][/color][/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Download Main File (Vanilla & Expanded) [/size]
[*][size=3]Download all requirements (follow the notes)[/size]
[*][size=3]Follow readme instruction in [color=#ff7700][b](CP)[/b] [b]Portrait Settings Vanilla[/b][/color] & [b][color=#ff7700](CP) [/color][/b][color=#ff7700][b]Portrait Settings Expanded[/b][/color][/size]
[/list][size=3]
[u]If you do not plan to play Stardew Valley Expanded you can download Vanilla only and ignore requirements for [/u][u]Fresh-styled portraits for SVE [/u], vice versa

[/size][size=3]Assets from [b][color=#ff7700]Fresh-styled Portraits for SVE[/color][/b], [b][color=#ff7700]OhoDavi Anime Unofficial 1.6 Portraits[/color][/b], and [b][color=#ff7700]stardewvalley anime mods[/color][/b] are only used as placeholders. 

[/size][color=#00ff00][size=5]Update 2.0.0[/size][/color]
[size=4]Allow you to freely change portrait resolution in settings while playing for global or partial
You can delete previous version (assets still same so you can relocate it first) [/size][color=#ff0000]
[/color]
